_readme: Hand-edited config for known gaps in pokemon-go-api's upstream data that npm run sync patches in from PokeAPI. Edit freely — this file is read fresh on every sync, no code changes or redeploy needed. Released Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokemon are NOT listed here: npm run sync reads them from Bulbapedia (server/src/bulbapedia.ts), including per-form Dynamax releases (Toxtricity, Urshifu) and announced releases, which only appear once their date arrives — the old releasedDynamaxDexNumbers, releasedGigantamaxDexNumbers and formSplitDynamaxDexNumbers keys are no longer read and can be deleted. dmaxOnlyFinalEvolution: when true, a species Bulbapedia lists as Dynamax-capable is silently skipped unless it's the final stage of its evolution line (pokemon-go-api's own evolutions: [] signal) — e.g. Bulbasaur/Ivysaur produce no DMax entry, only Venusaur does. Set false to include every stage Bulbapedia lists. formSplitGigantamaxDexNumbers: species whose Gigantamax art genuinely differs per form even though pokemon-go-api and Bulbapedia both list a single Gigantamax entry (Toxtricity) — split into one GMax entry per form, each using PokeAPI's per-form gmax sprite. regionFormAssetBackfill: species where pokemon-go-api has null assets for BOTH the base species AND every one of its regionForms (Squawkabilly, Wishiwashi, Silvally, Minior, Mimikyu, Magearna, Eiscue, Calyrex, Palafin, Koraidon, Miraidon) — entirely absent from the catalog otherwise, unlike missingAssetLinkDexNumbers/backfillMissingAssetsFromPokeApi which deliberately skip any species with regionForms (to avoid the Unown/Burmy/Wormadam duplicate-row bug). Each entry maps a specific regionForms key to an exact PokeAPI variety slug — hand-specified, not derived mechanically, since the mapping isn't uniform (Silvally's 17 types all share ONE PokeAPI sprite since no per-type art exists; Koraidon/Miraidon's GO-exclusive raid forms have no PokeAPI equivalent at all and fall back to the base sprite; Minior maps to PokeAPI's colored Core variety, not the generic rocky Meteor shell variety; Squawkabilly/Wishiwashi/Mimikyu/Eiscue/Palafin map cleanly but still need PokeAPI's exact slug spelling, which isn't always a mechanical lowercase of pokemon-go-api's own form name — e.g. Squawkabilly's colors need a trailing '-plumage'). baseFormAssetBackfill: for a species whose base assets AND every regionForm/assetForm are also null (so backfillMissingAssetsFromPokeApi's automatic pass — which deliberately skips any species with non-empty regionForms/assetForms, to avoid the Unown/Burmy/Wormadam duplicate-row bug — leaves it with no catalog row at all), this explicitly backfills just the base species sprite from the given PokeAPI slug. Only list a species here after confirming its regionForms/assetForms are never real independently-catchable forms (e.g. Cramorant's GULPING/GORGING are battle-only transient states) — otherwise use regionFormAssetBackfill instead, or both. regionFormNameOverrides: corrects known-wrong names.English values on specific regionForms — confirmed pokemon-go-api data bugs, not something transform.ts's existing genericName fallback catches. costumeGenderEnabled: controls whether the Costume Dex treats gendered costume pairs as two entries at all — both in the main grid (a female costume card is hidden, same as the existing 'Gender Forms' toggle but scoped just to the Costume pokedexType) and in the Search Strings dialog (hides the Male/Female breakdown section, in addition to Default/Shiny). Unlike Mega/GMax/DMax/XXL/XXS, costume entries sometimes come in real male/female pairs (see transform.ts's findGenderedFormKeys), so this is opt-out rather than structurally absent. Served live to the frontend via GET /api/search-config — no npm run sync needed to change it.

missingAssetLinkDexNumbers.name: Zeraora
missingAssetLinkDexNumbers.notes: pokemon-go-api leaves assets: null, but real sprite art exists at the standard pm{dexNr}.icon.png URL in its own asset repo — an upstream linking gap, not an unreleased species.

formSplitGigantamaxDexNumbers.name: Toxtricity
formSplitGigantamaxDexNumbers.notes: pokemon-go-api only lists one generic GIGANTAMAX assetForm, but Gigantamax Toxtricity's appearance genuinely differs by which form (Amped/Low Key) evolved into it — confirmed via PokeAPI's separate toxtricity-amped-gmax/toxtricity-low-key-gmax varieties (visually distinct art). Split into one GMax entry per form here instead of the single generic one.

regionFormAssetBackfill.name: Silvally
regionFormAssetBackfill.notes: PokeAPI has only ONE sprite for the whole species — no per-type art exists anywhere (a held-item color tint in the mainline games, not a separate asset) — so every regionForm below intentionally maps to the same 'silvally' slug.

regionFormAssetBackfill.name: Minior
regionFormAssetBackfill.notes: Mapped to PokeAPI's colored 'Core' varieties (minior-red etc.), not the generic rocky 'Meteor' shell varieties — confirmed visually distinct; Core matches GO's color-named forms.

regionFormAssetBackfill.name: Koraidon
regionFormAssetBackfill.notes: KORAIDON_APEX is a GO-exclusive raid form with no mainline-game equivalent — falls back to the base species' own PokeAPI sprite.

regionFormAssetBackfill.name: Miraidon
regionFormAssetBackfill.notes: Same as Koraidon — MIRAIDON_ULTIMATE is GO-exclusive, falls back to the base sprite.

baseFormAssetBackfill.name: Cramorant
baseFormAssetBackfill.notes: pokemon-go-api has assets: null for the base species AND both regionForms (CRAMORANT_GULPING/CRAMORANT_GORGING) — no sprite exists anywhere upstream. Unlike backfillMissingAssetsFromPokeApi, this list intentionally backfills the BASE species even though regionForms is non-empty, because Gulping/Gorging are battle-only transient states (Surf/Dive triggered mid-battle), never independently catchable — only the base Normal Form should ever appear in the catalog. Do not add a regionFormAssetBackfill entry for CRAMORANT_GULPING/CRAMORANT_GORGING; that would incorrectly surface battle-only forms as catchable.

regionFormNameOverrides.name: Squawkabilly (White Plumage)
regionFormNameOverrides.notes: pokemon-go-api's own names.English for this regionForm is wrong — it says 'Squawkabilly (White Kyurem)', an apparent copy-paste error from Kyurem's own form naming, unrelated to Squawkabilly. Corrected here to match its Blue/Green/Yellow siblings' naming pattern. Only surfaced once regionFormAssetBackfill above gave this regionForm a real sprite — it previously produced no row at all, so the wrong name was invisible.
